events.summary: As the vault collapses, Kellan makes sure Akul cannot follow them out.
events.quote: As the vault collapsed around them, Kellan made sure Akul couldn't follow them out.

events.summary: Kellan wills a train to stop with no plan.
events.quote: He simply poured his focus into the train and willed it to stop.

events.summary: Nolan refuses to reveal the vault's location and a strange figure reads his mind.
events.quote: Nolan refused to give up the vault's location.

events.summary: A runaway train tears through Prosperity with its new conductors reveling in the destruction.
events.quote: The runaway train tore through the manicured streets of Prosperity

events.summary: Vraska lets Oko believe he holds all the cards while her own scheme unfolds.
events.quote: Letting Oko believe he held all the cards provided the perfect cover for her own scheme to unfold.

events.summary: Ludevic sends Kraum to make sure Geralf gets into the right kind of trouble.
events.quote: Ludevic sent his greatest creation to make sure Geralf got into the right kind of trouble.

events.summary: Akul regards his Hellspur followers as ammunition to be expended.
events.quote: Akul saw his Hellspur followers as little more than ammunition to be expended.

relations.quote: You're not mad I pulled a little prank.
